QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_36

question.text: In the SSE ecosystem, Trading Members provide platforms for donation via which of the following channels?

answer.text: Only cash deposits at the exchange counter.
Demand drafts and bearer cheques only.
Application Supported by Blocked Amounts (ASBA) and Unified Payment Interface (UPI) based donations.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.54 of the workbook, Trading Members provide a platform for Application Supported by Blocked Amounts (ASBA) and Unified Payment Interface (UPI) based donations. ASBA is the standard IPO payment mechanism; UPI extends retail access to donors on the SSE. The Trap: Option A (cash) is not the SSE donation channel. Options B and D describe obsolete or unsuitable instruments for this flow. Note: Stick to the p.54 wording (ASBA and UPI) when describing the donation channels offered by Trading Members.
